description:
October brought major updates across the GitHub ecosystem, but what do these changes actually mean for your team's day-to-day work? In this edition of the GitHub Changelog, join the team as they demystify "software factories" and break down practical tools inside the GitHub Copilot app. Explore how self-learning Copilot automations handle issue triage, how Copilot Projects orchestrates multi-repo work without local cloning, and how Copilot Fusion routes tasks across frontier models. Learn how to automate routine pipeline tasks so you can focus on building software.

description:
Big pull requests slow everyone down, creating review bottlenecks, stalling feedback loops, and disrupting developer momentum. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, discover how GitHub stacked PRs allow you to split complex changes into smaller, dependent pull requests that move through review smoothly while maintaining full context. Watch as Sameen Karim from GitHub builds a stack with the GitHub CLI, conducts reviews on github.com, and merges each pull request as soon as it is approved. Leave with practical workflows you can apply directly to your team's repository today. 

Speakers: 
Sameen Karim, Senior Product Manager, GitHub
